description: A moody, intimate bedroom vignette focused on the nightstand area. The wall is painted a warm off-white with a subtle warm undertone. A rich deep chocolate brown velvet floor-to-ceiling curtain panel is drawn on the right side, adding warmth and depth. A cone of warm amber glow washes down from above onto the nightstand surface, illuminating the vase arrangement and candle from overhead, creating a golden circle of light on the marble surface. The mood is quiet, romantic, and darkly cozy — moody Nordic with classical undertones.
